Stara Pryluka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Stara Pryluka split off from its twin town, Nova Pryluka, in the early 18th century, with most subsequent Jewish communal life concentrated in the newer settlement — leaving just 150 Jews here by 1897, out of 2,321 residents. This cemetery, established in the 18th century, was demolished during Soviet collectivization in the 1930s, notably predating the WWII-era destruction that claimed most cemeteries in this collection. No local residents could confirm the cemetery's existence today, though they pointed to a nearby mass grave.
